scope: Frozen transfer to previously exposed 2023; U exploratory under approved R1; statistical stream only
settings: Exact saved 2021 models and selected 2022 A3 decisions; no fitting, calibration, candidate selection or automatic retuning
context: Source 18-31 December 2022, 336 unscored hours, state zero at context start. Source 1 January-31 December 2023 scored; HH24 retains original source-date ownership.
FPR: Strict S01 positives / ready eligible assumed-normal source-2023 hours, annual and source month; unavailable excluded with reasons, zero denominator null. Not whole-H FPR or final-year evaluation.
diagnosis: Annual statistical FPR strictly above .01 or any monthly FPR strictly above .03 prompts diagnosis/disclosure. Equality does not trigger. Missing exposure is explicit diagnosis_required. Adverse findings may be retained with unchanged settings under A3; never automatically retune.
state: First ready update 228; hold through six unavailable hours then reset at seventh; continuous without monthly resets; no reference fallback
failure: Permission/hash/input/resource errors preserve failed attempt. Elevated FPR is a scientific diagnosis result, not execution failure. Fresh folder on rerun; no partial resume.
later: Review validation, then scientific integration/prospective final protocol, controlled structural intake/independent labels, actual freeze and measured pilot. No final intake or final batch authorised by this stage.
